definitions.explanation: The clearing, degradation, or destruction of forests, typically caused by logging, agriculture, or urban development. A major global environmental concern.

examples.japanese: {森林破壊|しんりんはかい}が{進|すす}んでいる。
{森林破壊|しんりんはかい}は{地球温暖化|ちきゅうおんだんか}の{原因|げんいん}のひとつだ。
examples.english: Deforestation is one of the causes of global warming.

examples.japanese: {違法|いほう}な{伐採|ばっさい}による{森林破壊|しんりんはかい}を{食|く}い{止|と}めるため、{国際的|こくさいてき}な{取|と}り{組|く}みが{求|もと}められている。
examples.english: International efforts are needed to halt deforestation caused by illegal logging.

notes:
USAGE:
{森林破壊|しんりんはかい} is used in news, environmental discussions, and academic writing. It is a compound of {森林|しんりん} (forest) and {破壊|はかい} (destruction).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {森林破壊|しんりんはかい}を{防|ふせ}ぐ (to prevent deforestation)
- {森林破壊|しんりんはかい}が{進|すす}む (deforestation advances)
- {森林破壊|しんりんはかい}を{食|く}い{止|と}める (to halt deforestation)
- {森林破壊|しんりんはかい}の{問題|もんだい} (the problem of deforestation)
